remarks: Bright and spacious 2nd-floor apartment conveniently located at 61 Van Zant St, just a short walk to the train station, bus lines, shops, and local amenities. UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED!! This well-maintained unit features generously sized rooms, updated flooring throughout, and an eat-in kitchen with ample cabinet and counter space. Sun-filled living areas and neutral finishes create a clean, inviting feel. One off-street parking space included for added convenience. All utilities are included in the rent, making for easy, predictable monthly living. A great commuter-friendly location with quick access to downtown and major routes.
